actions.title: Build the web game (Vite + React + TS)
actions.instructions: Implement every spec story in projects/xo-online/app: pure game/room logic, Transport interface (MQTT public broker, BroadcastChannel local mode, in-memory for tests), hash routes, i18n Arabic/English RTL, animated professional UI, accessibility; base from BASE_PATH; test and build:preview scripts.
actions.summary: Built the game with pure logic modules (game, room, client, transport, i18n) and 11 components. CSS-only animations (SVG stroke drawing for X/O, win line, confetti) honouring prefers-reduced-motion. MQTT library lazy-loaded.

review.notes: Re-ran npm ci (0 vulnerabilities), npm test (27 passed), build:preview with base path (ok). Fixed MEDIUM: locked visitor never retried joining when the seat reopened. Accepted LOW risks: seat-race takeover window, spoofing on the public broker (version/updatedAt), lobby idle measured from last move not presence, 24 h cleanup trusts the local clock.

actions.body: Build approved by James after one fix. George now writes acceptance tests and CI. Live online play can only be confirmed on the preview.
